items.item: Notices the test has no assertions and rejects coverage-only testing
items.evidence: the test has no assertions. It inserts one Account and one Opportunity, calls `apply`, and checks nothing, so 90% coverage only shows the lines ran.

items.item: Asks for asserts on the expected values, a bulk test and a negative case before approving
items.evidence: use `Assert.areEqual(expected, actual)` on each field; "Add one that runs 200+ Opportunities"; "Add Opportunities on a non-Partner Account and one with a null `AccountId`"; "I haven't approved T-012."
